identity.title: Sub-arcsecond (Sub)millimeter Imaging of the Massive Protocluster G358.93-0.03: Discovery of 14 New Methanol Maser Lines Associated with a Hot Core

paper_type_evidence.quote: Using SMA and ALMA, we have discovered 14 new Class II CH$_3$OH maser lines ranging in frequency from 199 to 361 GHz

evidence.quote: Lacking a maser parallax distance, we use the MM1 $v_{\rm LSR}$ to derive a near kinematic distance of 6.75 kpc (cite: Reid14).

question.value: What are the (sub)millimeter continuum and line (maser and thermal) properties of the protocluster G358.93-0.03 after its 6.7 GHz methanol maser flare, and is there evidence of a protostellar accretion outburst?

evidence.quote: Since the 6.7 GHz CH$_3$OH maser flare in G358.93$-$0.03 may be indicative of a massive protostellar outburst event, the M2O group has pursued multi-wavelength follow-up with telescopes worldwide
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2018.A.00031.T.

findings_qualitative.value: Masers trace a curvilinear pattern around MM1 inconsistent with simple disk rotation; no significant continuum change between epochs

evidence.quote: The pattern is not consistent with simple rotation of an inclined circular disk

claims.hypothesis: Are there new Class II methanol maser lines in the flare?
claims.finding: First evidence vt=2 levels involved in Class II maser pumping

evidence.quote: The latter detection provides the first observational evidence that Class II maser pumping involves levels in the ${\rm v}_t$=2 state.

claims.hypothesis: Did the continuum brighten significantly because of an accretion outburst?
claims.experiment: Compare epochs and prior ATLASGAL flux
claims.result: No significant change in continuum flux
claims.finding: No conclusive evidence for dust heating

evidence.quote: the lack of conclusive evidence for dust heating is perplexing

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Disk rotation interpretation of masers and thermal gas rejected in favor of ring/outflow cavity or spiral filament

evidence.quote: Such a morphology could arise from the walls of an outflow cavity.
This estimate has considerable uncertainty ($+0.37, -0.68$ kpc reported by the model)
